explanation: It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and nearly always 0 at D1, except at D1 around trials 49-59 of the episode when the agent has kept choosing a1 and gone unrewarded on about 3-4 or more trials in a row. Then it jumps to 8-10, usually rising across a run of consecutive misses (for example 8, then 9, then 10), and it drops back to 0 as soon as a reward arrives; long losing streaks with a2, or earlier or later in the episode, stay at 0.
